devicedata.name: Roku Bridge
devicedata.model: Roku players and TVs - Search and Control

property.name: Roku Address
property.tooltip: IP address of the Roku (port 8060 assumed). Give the Roku a DHCP reservation.

property.name: Power Commands

items.item: Go Home when room turns off
Roku TV: power on and off

property.tooltip: Off sends nothing when the room turns on or off. The Roku TV option only works on Roku TVs, not sticks or boxes.

property.name: Select Room Source
property.tooltip: Whether a launch from programming also selects Roku Bridge in the room. Skipped when the room is already on it.

property.name: Recent List Size
property.tooltip: How many recently launched titles to remember.

property.name: Now Playing Refresh (s)
property.tooltip: How often the Now Playing bar re-reads the Roku while this source is selected. 0 turns it off.

property.name: Search API Key
property.tooltip: Free key from Movie of the Night (docs.movieofthenight.com, Authentication guide) or from RapidAPI. The same key works for Shield Bridge.

property.name: Search API Service
property.tooltip: Where the Search API Key came from.

property.name: Search Country
property.tooltip: Two-letter country code (us, ca, gb ...). Results only include what streams in this country.

property.name: Show Titles Not On Roku
property.tooltip: Also list matches on channels that are not installed, with the option to add the channel.
